candidates.title: 'We trusted EC in 2017': Akhilesh alleges poll officials deleted SP votes in 2022
candidates.excerpt: Akhilesh Yadav has accused the Election Commission of deliberately deleting votes belonging to the Samajwadi Party. He argues that this malpractice has been ongoing for years but is only now gaining attention. In his statement, he noted that voters from the 2019 elections were unjustly denied the opportunity to vote in 2022. This controversy follows recent revelations about objections within the Election Commission regarding the electoral rolls revision.

candidates.title: 'Oye maar kaise raha hai': On cam, Delhi minister Parvesh Verma slaps man
candidates.excerpt: Captured on video during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi, PWD Minister Parvesh Verma's unexpected slap to a young man has stirred controversy. Released by the Aam Aadmi Party, the footage shows Verma confronting the individual before a security guard intervenes. This incident has ignited debate regarding the behavior of public servants in the line of duty, attracting the attention of numerous onlookers.

candidates.title: Kapil Sibal alleges ‘unilateral’ EC decisions, seeks action against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
candidates.excerpt: Kapil Sibal has raised concerns over the Election Commission's decision-making under Gyanesh Kumar during a ten-month period. His allegations include that decisions were made unilaterally, bypassing other commissioners and statutory protocols. Sibal has called for an investigation into the electoral rolls and recent elections conducted in Bihar and West Bengal. In response, the Election Commission acknowledged concerns and proposed several corrective measures to address them.

candidates.title: Russian Strikes Kill Four in Ukraine, Damage Kyiv Data Center
candidates.excerpt: Russia’s overnight airstrikes killed at least four people across Ukraine and hit a data center in Kyiv, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

candidates.title: 'Didn't collect ID': Guwahati homestay where student, ‘lover’ stayed 5 times sealed
candidates.excerpt: Nimisha Thakuria's death has prompted police to seal Rudra’s Kitchen homestay at Dharapur. Investigators are examining guest documentation and prior visits made by her and Ashiq Ali. Police indicated that Ali's claim of suicide has not yet been confirmed. The circumstances surrounding Nimisha's unconscious state and subsequent death are being explored. Authorities are investigating all possible angles related to the case.

candidates.title: UP double murder: Retired Army man, 1st wife found dead in pool of blood
candidates.excerpt: In a tragic event, retired Army veteran Shamsuddin and his wife Saddo Begum were discovered murdered in their residence, the police alerted by neighbors. Their bodies were located amidst a pool of blood, prompting forensic experts and a dog squad to join the inquiry. With the motive still unknown, multiple investigation teams are being formed.
